policy: Metadata only. No payloads. Match package name + version range.

advisories.title: Vyper @nonreentrant lock compiled incorrectly
advisories.summary: Compiler versions 0.2.15 through 0.3.0 emitted a broken reentrancy lock. Curve pools were exploited in July 2023.

advisories.title: Vyper 0.3.7 storage corruption
advisories.summary: Certain storage layouts were compiled incorrectly in 0.3.7.

advisories.title: Vyper 0.3.10 sqrt / range edge cases
advisories.summary: Review any 0.3.10 deployment against the published advisories before treating it as current.

advisories.title: GovernorVotesQuorumFraction quorum updates not retroactive
advisories.summary: Quorum updates could leave proposals in an inconsistent state. Upgrade to 4.8.3+ or 4.9+.

advisories.title: ERC721Consecutive balance corruption
advisories.summary: Consecutive minting could corrupt balances. Fixed in 4.8.2.

advisories.title: TransparentUpgradeableProxy admin collision class
advisories.summary: Older transparent-proxy helpers had selector/admin pitfalls. Prefer 4.8.3+ or 5.x.

advisories.title: Initializable reentrancy / implementation takeover class
advisories.summary: Older Initializable did not disable initializers on the implementation. Attackers could become owner and brick proxies.

advisories.title: Older solmate SafeTransferLib edge cases
advisories.summary: Early SafeTransferLib versions had nonstandard-token edge cases. Prefer current solmate or solady.

advisories.title: Pre-0.29 Anchor constraint / close classes
advisories.summary: Older Anchor releases had several account-close and constraint soundness fixes. Pin >=0.29 and review close/init_if_needed.

advisories.title: Legacy SPL token crate
advisories.summary: Very old spl-token crates predate Token-2022 awareness. Confused-deputy risk if both programs are accepted.

advisories.title: Hardhat default accounts must never hold mainnet funds
advisories.summary: The well-known Hardhat/Anvil mnemonic is public. Config that points those keys at a live network is a live key leak.

advisories.title: ERC-2771 context / Multicalled context issues in early 5.x
advisories.summary: Early OpenZeppelin 5.0.x releases received context-related fixes. Prefer the latest 5.x patch.
